summary: Looks good. Smoke recipe PASS, tsc PASS, 50/50 unit tests PASS. Two nitpicks in perps-fill-tag.tsx — please address before merge.

comments.body: Suggestion: `e.stopPropagation()` is no longer required. After the nested-button refactor in `transaction-card.tsx`, this `<button>` is rendered as a sibling of the row `ButtonBase`, not nested inside it — so the click never bubbles to a parent interactive ancestor. Safe to drop the handler-arg and the `stopPropagation` line to keep the call site honest about why ADL is decoupled from the row.

Suggestion: the four `!== null && !== undefined` guards are redundant — `isEqualCaseInsensitive` already returns `false` for non-string inputs (see `shared/lib/string-utils.ts`). Simplify to:

```ts
condition: isEqualCaseInsensitive(
  fill.liquidation?.liquidatedUser ?? '',
  selectedAccount?.address ?? '',
),
```

Same behavior, less noise.
